newsitem.title: USA: Green Oasis trades temporarily suspended.
newsitem.headline: Green Oasis trades temporarily suspended.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said Friday it has temporarily suspended trading in Green Oasis Environmental Inc until May 22.
The agency said it suspended trades "because of questions that have been raised about the accuracy and adequacy of publicly disseminated information."
Green Oasis, with headquarters in Charleston, S.C., is engaged in the business of developing and selling equipment to process waste motor oil into more valuable fuel.
